purpose: Independent lifetime-growth and current-backlog signals. Nine complete plant layers, not nine levels of one linear progression.

semantics.transition: Keep current maturity when watering; drooping -> recovering -> healthy within same maturity. Never die; never reset lifetime growth. Backend owns thresholds and recovery duration.

placement.coordinate_system: top-left origin, normalized against native 1536x1024 background; use full transparent layer canvas, never auto-trim by alpha bounding box

validation.visual_review: All nine composited over actual empty-sill room at documented rectangle; inspected contact sheet. Pots fit sill, broad and narrow leaves occupy window rather than furniture, tiny/medium/mature silhouettes distinguish lifetime growth. Droop remains alive; recovery carries dew.
validation.alpha_review: All plant PNGs RGBA with actual alpha0 pixels. Most source interiors peak at253/254 rather than255, near-opaque. Fine low-alpha fringe pixels make raw alpha bounding boxes misleading; do not trim or use them for placement. Coloured RGB in alpha0 areas is invisible in normal compositing.

minor_deviations: Generator did not retain exact numeric pot geometry; seedling plant columns were resized independently using their existing alpha, and all stages baseline-registered. At the intended 430px wide room placement, residual pot size/center differences are a few pixels. Use short crossfade rather than hard swapping if desired.
Pot motifs and leaf placement vary slightly between conditions; same blue-white/terracotta/jade identities retained.
Recovering dew is visually subtle at room scale; pair watering with app animation or accessible state text.
Thriving has four open pink flowers, not the five requested in its prompt.
Actual generated palette is brighter green and somewhat more textured than original room, but compatible at native placement.
cost_note: Image cost unknown; model IDs and usage not exposed by built-in tool.
